verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own natural-language interfaces: in-app plain-English questions, AI tasks that are described once and then run automatically, and Accounting AI prompts over the ledger. Its first-party MCP server lets Claude or ChatGPT query financials conversationally. However, operating the product through natural-language actions (write access) is only in Beta with per-change confirmation, so read-heavy querying is better evidenced than full command-driven operation. missing for 10: generally available natural-language write and operation coverage across the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these natural-language workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
With write access turned on (Beta), your assistant can also make changes... It confirms each change with you before making it.
run a forecast as an AI task, or ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP.
